address: 普陀区铜川路699弄1号中海环宇城L1层L1011, 上海市（距地铁11号线真如站出入口步行430米）
description_en: Dessert bakery run by Shanghai Bebeike Catering Co., Ltd (上海彼焙窠餐饮有限责任公司). WeChat mini-program: bebaked (in-store pickup or delivery); Xiaohongshu: bebaked. This location is inside Zhenru Universal City MAX mall, a 430m walk from an exit of Zhenru station on metro Line 11. Hours 10:00-22:00. Menu: thousand-layer matcha roll, black sesame mochi Basque cheesecake, oozing matcha cocoa tart, black sesame soy milk roll, caramel mille-feuille tart. Prices run 10-45rmb. bebaked has 2 locations in Shanghai (Yuyuan Lane House, Zhenru Universal City).
description_zh: 以甜品烘焙为主的品牌，由上海彼焙窠餐饮有限责任公司运营。微信小程序：bebaked（可以门店自提或外送到家）；小红书：bebaked。本店位于真如环宇城MAX商场内，距地铁11号线真如站出入口步行430米，营业时间10:00-22:00。菜单：千目抹茶卷、黑芝麻麻薯巴斯克、流心抹茶可可挞、黑芝麻豆乳卷、焦糖千层挞，价格在10-45rmb之间。bebaked在上海共有2家门店（愚园洋房店、真如环宇城店）。
